description: This PHP source file defines the class OX_Maintenance_Statistics_MigrateBucketData, which implements functions for migrating and summarizing bucket data into statistics tables within the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for locating plugin components, preparing migration maps, and executing data summarization.

classes.name: OX_Maintenance_Statistics_MigrateBucketData
classes.description: A class that handles migrating bucket data into statistics tables, including locating plugin components, preparing migration maps, and summarizing data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object, establishing a database connection and retrieving installed plugin packages.

methods.name: summarise
methods.description: Summarizes bucket data into statistics tables for a given date range.

methods.name: locateComponents
methods.description: Locates and instantiates plugin components that extend 'deliveryLog' and are enabled, grouped by their destination statistics table.

methods.name: prepareMaps
methods.description: Converts located components into migration maps suitable for processing, handling only aggregate bucket types.
